answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted onboarding: every new agent must lock a bond that acts as an anchor to its identity, and that bond only unlocks after months of honest work verified by unrelated peers. A sybil farm spawning a thousand agents must freeze a thousand bonds, a cold tundra of idle capital, and any proven collusion slashes them all. Reputation then accrues slowly, like basalt layers cooling, so cheap fake identities never earn real weight.
